name: Vauntblade Duelist

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The duelist makes three attacks, using Blade or Dart in any combination.

Actions.name: Blade
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 28 (5d8 + 6) Slashing damage.

Actions.name: Dart
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +10, range 20/60 ft. 23 (7d4 + 6) Piercing damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Umbral Step
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the duelist takes the Hide action.

Reactions.name: Seized Opening
Reactions.text: *Trigger:* The first time on its turn a creature within the duelist's reach makes an attack, casts a spell, or leaves a square the duelist threatens. *Response:* The duelist makes one Blade attack against that creature with Advantage, ignoring the Disadvantage imposed by the target being hidden from it or by the duelist being unseen.
Reactions.expresses: a single strike that never misses

lore: A duelist sworn to a single-strike school of blade-craft, it roams the hidden places of the world challenging any who meet its eye to a duel of one blow — and it has never lost one.

generation.userConcept: a duellist who only ever makes one attack, and it always lands
generation.cite: composition after Assassin (CR 8) — the rider-heavy burst and the expertise Stealth

monsterDescription: a duellist who only ever makes one attack, and it always lands
